_comment: Radio receiver profiles for HF Band Scout drilldown panel. Keys: model id → bands → conditionKey → settings. conditionKey = noise_low_kp_low | noise_low_kp_high | noise_high_kp_low | noise_high_kp_high

noise_low_kp_low.note: Low noise floor on 160m. Roofing filter helps adjacent QRM.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Elevated Kp causes QSB. Fast AGC protects eardrums. NB2 if ignition noise.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Pre-amp OFF on noisy 160m. NB reduces local power-line buzz.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Worst case. Consider 30-Hz IF filter on CW. QSO may not be worth it.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Preamp 1 adds 10 dB; skip if S-meter pegs.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Geomagnetic activity raises absorption. NB2 for lightning storms.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Urban noise floor limits 80m gain. Keep preamp OFF.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Band likely noisy and unreliable. Try FT8 before SSB.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 40m usually reliable. Preamp 1 for DX.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Moderate solar activity. Watch for rapid QSB.

noise_high_kp_low.note: High QRM on 40m evenings; NB2 helps.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Challenging. FT8 on 7074 kHz more robust than SSB.

noise_low_kp_low.note: CW/digi only. Excellent DX band. Preamp 1 for weak signals.

noise_low_kp_high.note: FT8 on 10136 kHz holds up well under moderate Kp.

noise_high_kp_low.note: No SSB competition here; NR helps with low-level buzz.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Digi modes only. FT8 outperforms CW in these conditions.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 20m workhorse band. 2.8 kHz passband captures full SSB.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Solar activity manageable on 20m. Narrow filter if pileup.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Urban location: NB1 to reduce local hash.

noise_high_kp_high.note: MUF may drop during K≥5 storm. Check 17m as fallback.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Preamp 2 (+20 dB) useful on 17m for DX signals.

noise_low_kp_high.note: MUF sensitive to Kp on 17m. Be ready for quick QSB.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Preamp 1 even in urban; 17m relatively quiet noise-wise.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Band may be closed. Try 20m or 15m.

noise_low_kp_low.note: High solar flux opens 15m. Preamp 2 for grey-line DX.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Elevated Kp can close 15m quickly. Log SFI before calling CQ.

noise_high_kp_low.note: 15m quieter than 40/80m; NB1 if any interference.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Storm absorption heavy. 15m likely shut. Check 10m Sporadic-E.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 12m excellent at solar max. Very low noise band.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Minor Kp effect on 12m in good solar conditions.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Urban location less of a problem at 24 MHz.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Check 12m even in storms — sometimes still open via F2.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Solar max: 10m can be wide open worldwide. Exciting band!

noise_low_kp_high.note: Kp <4: still usable. Watch for sudden MUF drop.

noise_high_kp_low.note: 10m noise floor low even in cities. Preamp 2 safe here.

noise_high_kp_high.note: High Kp hits 10m hard. Try Es or wait for storm to pass.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Magic band. Monitor FT8 on 50.313 MHz constantly.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Es openings independent of Kp. Don't give up!

noise_high_kp_low.note: Low band noise on 6m. Preamp 2 recommended.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Kp affects F2 on 6m but not Es. Keep watching.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 2m troposcatter/Es. FT8 on 144.174 MHz. Low noise.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Aurora on 2m possible during high Kp! Listen for CW buzz.

noise_high_kp_low.note: External LNA before feedline recommended for VHF.

noise_high_kp_high.note: High Kp = aurora mode. Expect rapid QSB on CW, try FT8.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Dual-watch useful: monitor 14.074 and 14.195 simultaneously.

noise_low_kp_high.note: RMDR >110 dB keeps adjacent signals clean during contests.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Roofing filter 600 Hz standard. Excellent for pileups.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Storm conditions. Use scope to quickly find open segment.

noise_low_kp_low.note: IP3 >+40 dBm handles contest QRM well.

noise_low_kp_high.note: NB1 reduces power-line noise on evening 40m.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Use spectrum scope to id clear frequencies.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Stormy 40m. FT8 more reliable.

noise_low_kp_low.note: AMP1 (+10 dB) for DX. Contour filter can enhance audio.

noise_low_kp_high.note: NR level 3 is good balance on 991A.

noise_high_kp_low.note: IPO (preamp off) in noisy urban QTH.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Storm + noise: narrow filters, NR max.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 991A performs well on 40m. AMP1 helps for weaker DX.

noise_low_kp_high.note: NB helpful on evening 40m with static crashes.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Urban 40m: IPO + NR 5 + narrow SSB filter.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Difficult conditions. FT8 recommended.

noise_low_kp_low.note: AMP2 (+20 dB) on 10m at solar max.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Light NR helps without distorting 10m voice.

noise_high_kp_low.note: 10m noise generally low; modest settings sufficient.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Kp storm affects 10m via F2 absorption.

noise_low_kp_low.note: TS-890S roofing at 270 Hz — excellent for CW.

noise_low_kp_high.note: NR + NB combo effective. AI-based NR2 for 890S.

noise_high_kp_low.note: LNA OFF in high noise; IP3 better without it.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Use 270 Hz roofing for CW pileup or storm conditions.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Excellent dynamic range — contest-grade on 40m.

noise_low_kp_high.note: NB1 for lightning. NR AI-based (NR2) works well.

noise_high_kp_low.note: RF gain reduction may help more than NR in severe QRM.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Worst case. Reduce RF gain, use 270 Hz roofing.

noise_low_kp_low.note: Set gain 30–40 dB. RTL-SDR susceptible to overload on 20m.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Increase NR in SDR# plugin. AGC can cause desensitisation.

noise_high_kp_low.note: Lower gain to avoid ADC clipping in urban QRM.

noise_high_kp_high.note: RTL-SDR marginal in storm. WSJT-X FT8 still works often.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 40m can overload RTL-SDR at night. Use attenuator if needed.

noise_low_kp_high.note: Reduce gain 5 dB during storm periods to reduce noise floor.

noise_high_kp_low.note: High local noise + RTL-SDR noise floor = challenging.

noise_high_kp_high.note: Consider KiwiSDR remote instead for storm conditions.

noise_low_kp_low.note: 160m: preamp off, minimal NR, slow AGC.
80m: light preamp if needed.
40m: modest preamp, NR only if needed.
20m: generally clean, light settings.
15m: higher preamp for DX.
10m: max preamp, wide filter at solar max.
6m: always max preamp for Es signals.
